description: This Dart source file provides utility classes and methods for deterministic and hermetic golden testing in Flutter projects. It includes functions for handling test images, setting up the test environment, configuring golden file directories, loading fonts, and widget wrapping for consistent screenshots.

classes.name: GoldenTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering functions to aid in implementing deterministic and cross-platform golden tests in Flutter. Includes methods for setting up test directories, loading fonts, creating image providers, and wrapping test widgets with stable environment configurations.

classes.name: ControlledTestImageProvider
classes.description: An ImageProvider that doesn't resolve immediately, allowing tests to control when the image loads by calling `complete()`. Used for testing image loading states in a predictable manner.

classes.name: FailingTestImageProvider
classes.description: An ImageProvider that always fails to load, used to test error handling scenarios in image rendering.

methods.name: stableTestImageProvider
methods.description: Returns an ImageProvider with a fixed, known 2x2 PNG for stable image rendering in tests.

methods.name: controlledLoadingImageProvider
methods.description: Returns an ImageProvider that stays in a loading state until explicitly completed.

methods.name: failingTestImageProvider
methods.description: Returns an ImageProvider that always fails to load the image, useful for testing error widgets.

methods.name: harness
methods.description: Wraps a widget with a MaterialApp, fixed MediaQuery, and centered layout for consistent golden screenshots.

methods.name: scrollHarness
methods.description: Wraps a widget in a scrollable area with configurable padding, allowing tests for deferred loading and partial views.

methods.name: configureGoldens
methods.description: Configures the golden file comparator to use a specific directory (`test/`) for consistency.

methods.name: loadTestFont
methods.description: Loads a stable, bundled font (`Ahem`) to ensure consistent text metrics during tests.

methods.name: pumpForGolden
methods.description: Pumps the widget into the tester and ensures all animations and frames are settled before capturing a golden image.

methods.name: goldenPath
methods.description: Returns the relative file path for golden images within the `test/goldens/` directory.
